newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Zimbabwean shares seen firmer in active trade.
newsitem.headline: Zimbabwean shares seen firmer in active trade.

text.p: Zimbabwean industrials started the week on Monday active and firmer with brokers expecting increased stock-buying following the closure last Thursday of a new issue by a local merchant bank.

"We've now done away with all the new issues and there should be more investors coming back into the market. People are also expecting refunds from the National Merchant Bank issue which closed last week," one broker said.

The key industrial index added 7.65 points to close at 10,244.14 on the back of a 250-cent gain to 5,500 in newspaper group Zimpapers while farming implement manufacturer Zimplow put on 20 cents to 700. Communications group Apex at 275, Horticulture company Ariston at 230, TA Holdings at 190 and multi-industrials TZI at 1,010 were all up 10 cents.

Minings were quiet and largely unchanged but coal producer Wankie put on 10 cents to 550 and gold giant Ashanti lept 500 cents to 10,000, nudging the seven-share secondary index 2.99 points up to 1003.54.
